rows.note: Use this for the general mental ability to form images or ideas.

example.jyutping: ngo5 ge3 soeng2 zoeng6 lik6 hou2 fung1 fu3

rows.note: Use this when the imagination refers to a fantasy or a false idea rather than a mental ability.

example.jyutping: go2 go3 nam2 faat3 gan1 bun2 hai6 waan6 soeng2

rows.note: Use this when imagination means practical creativity or resourcefulness in producing ideas.

example.traditional: 呢個廣告真係好有創意。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gwong2 gou3 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 cong3 ji3
